claim_a: VAE accuracy insufficient for highly robust grasp generation
claim_b: Generation of Dex-Net 2.0, a training dataset of 6.7 million synthetic point clouds, parallel-jaw grasps, and analytic grasp metrics across 1,500 3D models; and development of a Grasp Quality Convolutional Neural Network (GQ-CNN) that classifies robust grasp poses in depth images.
